title: 个人健康记录在个性化健康AI中的效用评估
summary: 研究评估了大型语言模型（Gemini 3.0 Flash）在提供个人健康记录（PHR）上下文时回答用户健康查询的效用。使用2257个查询和1945份去标识化PHR，发现加入PHR数据后答案的有用性显著提升，并开发了评估框架识别LLM理解复杂PHR的不足。
summary_en: Evaluates LLM (Gemini 3.0 Flash) utility in answering health queries with PHR context. Using 2257 queries and 1945 PHRs, significant improvements in answer helpfulness were found. A new evaluation framework identifies gaps in LLM understanding of complex PHRs.
